story.title: The Enchanted Mountain
story.description: Once upon time on a mountain lived a wizard. His sole purpose was to guard the gem of destiny which encompassed all the laws of this world. The legend said that it's wielder would be able to bend reality to his will. The legendary mage Dalt Wisney used it 4500 years ago to create the first feerical age.

children.text: A dirt path follows the base of the mountain.  It clearly isn't an official road of the Kingdom, but rather something that the local inhabitants of the land have threaded for dozens of year. Even if wild herbs and flowers have tried to reclaim it, it is still clearly marked, and you follow it easily until the village.
Smoke is coming out of the chimneys as houses uncomfortably hug the side of the mountain. There is no grand entrance, just the same simple path that transforms into a sandy road amidst the dwellings.
You immediately locate the local inn in the distance.

actions.text: You go straight to the inn
You wonder pointlessly

children.text: Loriath resolves around a center square, where people busily handle their tasks.

actions.text: You head straight north, towards the mountain

children.text: You're given a hot, simple yet flavorful herbal infusion, and some bread. You sit quietly and enjoy the food.
The map depicts the mountain and its surroundings...
In lieu of an answer, the innkeeper growls softly and points to the old woman.

actions.text: You go talk to the old woman
You leave the inn

children.text: You see a small embarcation which is gonna help you go towards the center of the Lake

actions.text: You go in and row towards the center of the Lake

children.text: When heading towards the lake, you arrive in a millenial grove which is enlightened by the moonlight

actions.text: You stop a few minutes to take on this beautiful sight
You continue walking while admiring the ancient trees

children.text: The inn is a warm, welcoming place. At this time of day it's mostly empty, but there are still a few locals eating a late breakfast.
An old woman sits in a corner, near the fireplace, in front of mountains of papers.
The only other person in the room is the innkeeper, cutting carrots and onions. These will probably soon be added to the forever stew brewing in a marmite.

actions.text: You leave the place
You go sit next to old woman
You get closer to the counter to address the innkeeper

children.text: You ask her what she is currently doing here and what her name is ?
She stops singing and gazes at you with an
inquisitive
look

You sit for a minute on huge tree branch that almost seems like it was laid here for this exact purpose. The curved trees surround you like a calming presence. After a while, you feel refreshed and ready to go.

actions.text: Pick your stuff up and get going

children.text: Continuing to walk towards the mountain the fog becomes thicker and thicker. At first it seemed like going straight to the top was the easiest, most straight forward way to get to your goal, but as you gaze above you you get the feeling that maybe it wasn't.

actions.text: You light a candle and try to find my way through the fog.
You look a the skies far far above and try to find my way using the oldest map in the world
You go back on your tracks and try the eastern path towards the lake
You open the ancient scroll that was given to you by the old cartographer
You go back on your tracks try the village to west

children.text: You tread past the ancient grove towards the end of the trees you finally arrive at your destination and the view takes you breath away. The moonlight and the stars relflect their light on the surface of the lake giving it a mystical and eerie feeling.

actions.text: You take in this marvelous sight and continue walking towards the direction of the song

scenes.title: At the foot of the mountain

children.text: You find yourself at the foot of the legendary Mount Harendal which is said to be home to a feerical kingdom in which lives a mysterious wizard. The mountain in all of its majesty pierces the sky and disappears on the night sky. What do you do ?

actions.text: You head north towards the mountain
You head west towards the village of Loriath
You head east towards Glitterlake

children.text: You're now very close to the siren you can have a close-up of it's peculiar attributes as the color of her scales which is a shimery azure blue and it's golden eyes in which a vertical slit can be seen.

actions.text: You try speaking to her

children.text: You hear a song, a sweet melody that seems to lull you in

actions.text: You head towards the provenance of this song
You choose to ignore the song an set camp  and try your in the morning

children.text: The innkeeper is a tall woman with large shoulder and long brown-grey hair.

actions.text: Ask for food and drink
Ask for directions

children.text: You keep walking and you stop dead on your tracks because you can finally see the provenance of those songs. It's a chimerical being half woman with long aubrun hair and half fish with a long tail which end in a large fin. A CREATURE OF LEGENDS, A SIREN.

actions.text: You walk towards the creature waiting foe an eventual interaction

children.text: As you continue walking, you can't help but feel like maybe that wasn't the smartest decision of your life.
You reach an island of very small stature in which you can see a distant silouhette

actions.text: You walk towards the silouhette

children.text: Your skills - or maybe your
luck
- allow you to read in the sky. You make good progress for a few hours.
You intensely stare at the sky. Unfortunately, they don't seem to be talkative today. After a few minutes, still nothing.

actions.text: You keep walking blindly
You try to find your way towards the village or lake

children.text: The old woman reveals herself as the former Loriath's administrator. The scrolls in front of here are actually maps and registries of local matters.
You have a nice chat, and after hearing your story she decides to give one of her precious maps. In particular, it shows a way to reach the top of the mountain, the dwelling of the mysterious wizard.

actions.text: You leave the inn
You leave the village and try to reach the path to the top of  mountain
You leave the village and head towards the lake
